name: overtex
description: A complete LaTeX writing environment inside VS Code: build, live PDF preview and SyncTeX.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Building runs latexmk, which can execute code from a project's .latexmkrc, so building and cleaning are disabled until the workspace is trusted, and the TexLab language server is not started. Viewing an existing PDF still works.

commands.title: Add Citation from DOI or arXiv

overtex.latex.mainFile.description: Main .tex file, relative to the workspace root. Auto-detected when empty (`% !TEX root` comment, then `\documentclass`).

overtex.latex.engine.description: TeX engine latexmk drives. BibTeX/Biber passes are run automatically.

overtex.latex.outDir.description: Output directory for build artifacts, relative to the main file. Empty means next to the main file.

overtex.texlab.enabled.description: Run the TexLab language server for live diagnostics, completion (commands, environments, labels, citations), hover and go to definition. Needs `texlab` to be installed; skipped when the TexLab extension is installed.

overtex.texlab.chktex.description: Have TexLab run ChkTeX while you type and show its style warnings.

overtex.build.onSave.description: Build when a .tex or .bib file is saved.

overtex.viewer.autoOpen.description: Open the PDF preview after a successful build.

enumDescriptions: Show the PDF as it is.
Invert the pages' brightness: light text on a dark page. Hues are kept, but images are inverted too.
Dark pages with a dark or high contrast theme, light pages otherwise.
overtex.viewer.colorScheme.markdownDescription: How the PDF preview draws pages. Only the preview changes; the PDF file is untouched. **Toggle Dark PDF Preview** and the preview's toolbar button switch between light and dark.

overtex.wordCount.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the document's word count in the status bar, counted with `texcount` after each successful build. Needs `texcount`, which comes with TeX Live and MiKTeX.

overtex.wordCount.goal.markdownDescription: Word target for the document, shown as `1,234 / 5,000 words` with progress in the tooltip. `0` means no goal.

overtex.highlights.enabled.markdownDescription: Highlight `TODO`, `FIXME` and `XXX` comments and `\todo{…}` notes, and dim text TeX skips: `\iffalse … \fi` and `comment` environments.

overtex.mathPreview.enabled.markdownDescription: Show math rendered with MathJax when hovering over `$…$`, `\[…\]`, `equation`, `align` and other math. Macros from `\newcommand`, `\DeclareMathOperator` and `\def` in the file and the main file are used.

overtex.mathPreview.scale.markdownDescription: Size of the math hover preview.

overtex.submission.pageLimit.markdownDescription: Page limit that **Check Submission** warns about. `0` means no limit; the page count is reported either way.

overtex.submission.anonymous.markdownDescription: The paper goes to double-blind review: **Check Submission** also points at author names, affiliations, `\thanks`, acknowledgments and `pdfauthor`.

colors.description: Background of TODO, FIXME and XXX notes in LaTeX sources, also used for their scroll bar marks.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Overtex
walkthroughs.description: Install TeX, build your first document, and jump between the source and the PDF.

steps.title: Install a TeX distribution
steps.description:
Overtex needs latexmk and a TeX engine from TeX Live, MacTeX or MiKTeX.
[Check Installation](command:overtex.checkSetup)

steps.title: Open or create a document
steps.description:
Open a folder with your .tex files, or start from a template.
[New Document](command:overtex.newDocument)

steps.title: Build the PDF
steps.description:
Saving builds the project. Errors go to the Problems panel.
[Build Now](command:overtex.build)

steps.title: Preview and SyncTeX
steps.description:
Jump from the cursor to the PDF, and Cmd/Ctrl+click the PDF to jump back.
[Jump to PDF](command:overtex.forwardSearch)

steps.title: Live checking with TexLab (optional)
steps.description:
Install TexLab for live diagnostics and completion.
[Install TexLab](https://github.com/latex-lsp/texlab#installation)
